found : thePeerage, 2009 October 16 : (Clementina Elizabeth Heathcote-Drummond-Willoughby, Baroness Willoughby de Eresby; dau. of Peter Robert Drummond-Burrell, 21st Baron Willoughby de Eresby and Lady Sarah Clementina Drummond; married Gilbert John Heathcote, 1st Baron Aveland; was baptised with the name of Clementina Elizabeth Burrell-Drummond. Her married name became Heathcote. She succeeded to the title of  24th Baroness Willoughby de Eresby on 13 November 1871, suo jure. On 4 May 1872 Clementina Elizabeth Heathcote-Drummond-Willoughby, Baroness Willoughby de Eresby title's name changed to Clementina Elizabeth Heathcote-Drummond-Willoughby by Royal Licence.
